name: Armour piercing
effect: Characters struck by this weapon may not make any armour rolls.

name: Cumulative
effect: For every successive turn in which a character is struck by this weapon, the weapon does an additional +4 damage.

name: Explosive
effect: Any character or vehicle within 5cm of a character hit by this weapon suffers 1D6 damage.

name: Heavy
effect: Characters wielding this weapon suffer -1 to their agility.

name: Integral
effect: This weapon cannot be removed during a game.

name: Indirect
effect: When firing this weapon, first estimate the distance between the shooter and the target. On a straight line from the shooter to the target, place a marker at this estimated distance. Anything within 10cm of the area is hit by the weapon. This weapon does not need line of sight to select a target.

name: Poisonous
effect: Any character hit by this weapon takes 1D4 damage at the start of every turn. This damage cannot be stopped with armour.

name: Psychic
effect: The wielder of this weapon may choose to use their (P) score when making shoot/fight actions with it, instead of their (S) or (F) skill.

name: Reload
effect: After each attack made with this weapon, the wielder must use an action to reload it. This action uses 1 piece of ammo from the wielder's equipment.

name: Volatile
effect: If the user rolls a 10 when attempting a skill roll with this weapon then the weapon deals damage to the wielder rather than their target.
